wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 361451997 defines the connected 16-corner cathedral and projecting central tower. The tower’s three arcades, upper windows and tall spire follow the December 2008 exterior.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the nave, side ranges, projecting tower, tall historic spire and white dome. Near levels refine pointed openings, clock and figures.
limitations: The exterior represents December 2008. The first of the month is a representative date because the photo records only the month.
Heights, rear walls, roof divisions and exact step grades are approximate. The portico and niche figures are simplified.
Interior rooms and the retaining wall beyond the mapped church are outside the model.
